questions.prompt: A histogram has a longer tail on the left and most of the data on the right. What is the shape?
hints: The tail tells the direction of skew.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A longer left tail means the distribution is skewed left.

questions.prompt: For a symmetric distribution, the best measure of center is the ___.
hints: It works well when data are balanced.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Use the mean for symmetric data.

questions.prompt: For a skewed distribution, which measure of center should you use?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Use the median for skewed data.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the rule that states about 68% of data lie within 1 standard deviation of the mean for bell‑shaped data?
A bell‑shaped distribution has mean 50 and standard deviation 5. About what percent of data lie between 45 and 55?
hints: Apply the first part of the Empirical Rule.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: About 68% of data lie within 1 SD of the mean.

questions.prompt: In a skewed right distribution, the mean is usually ___ than the median.
hints: The tail pulls the mean toward it.
Skewed right = tail on the right = mean pulled to the right.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The mean is greater than the median in a skewed right distribution.

questions.prompt: If a histogram has bars of about the same height, the distribution is called ___.
For a symmetric distribution, which measure of spread is best?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Standard deviation is the best measure of spread for symmetric data.

questions.prompt: The five‑number summary consists of minimum, Q1, median, Q3, and ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The five‑number summary ends with the maximum.

questions.prompt: For bell‑shaped data, a value more than 2 standard deviations from the mean is considered ___.
A double histogram shows that Group A is symmetric and Group B is skewed right. Which group should use the median?
hints: Symmetric data can use the mean.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Only Group B (skewed right) should use the median.

questions.prompt: When comparing two distributions, if one has a larger standard deviation, it has more ___.
A data set is bell‑shaped with mean 100 and standard deviation 15. Between what two values do about 95% of the data lie? (Type like 70 and 130)
Which of the following is true about a symmetric distribution?
options: The mean and median are about equal.
The mean is much larger than the median.
The median is much larger than the mean.
There is always a tail on the right.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: In a symmetric distribution, the mean and median are about equal.

questions.prompt: In a histogram, the side with the longer, thinner bars is called the ___.
hints: It extends out from the main body.
